notes: The schedule-free rule is a transliteration of adamw_schedulefree_reference.py and is cross-checked against a literal re-implementation of that reference in tests/test_schedule_free.py.
Reported metrics use the averaged sequence (x), which is what the reference implementation's eval() mode evaluates; measuring at the training point would flatter the method.
The cosine baseline is tuned over both learning rate and min_lr_factor (examples/schedule-free-sweep.json, 21 trials), because an untuned baseline would make the paper's claim untestable.

Seed 7: schedule-free matches the tuned cosine on final test loss (0.12395906 vs 0.12381987, 0.1% apart) but takes about twice as long to reach the target (154 vs 80 epochs), and a plain constant learning rate is better than both on final loss (0.12228349).
